deterministic_metrics.recall_at_k: For a query, |gold relevant ∩ top-k retrieved| / |gold relevant|. Undefined if no gold relevant set.
deterministic_metrics.hit_rate_at_k: 1 if any gold relevant appears in top-k else 0.
deterministic_metrics.reciprocal_rank: 1/rank of first gold-relevant retrieved id, else 0.
deterministic_metrics.mean_reciprocal_rank: Mean of reciprocal_rank over tasks (single gold set per task here).
deterministic_metrics.ndcg_at_k_binary: nDCG@K with binary relevance; ideal DCG places all relevant docs at top.
deterministic_metrics.contamination_rate: Among top-k, fraction of ids marked as distractors (lower is better).

llm_judge_metrics_optional.retrieval_set_relevance: 0-5 Groq judge: does the retrieved summary set address the query?
llm_judge_metrics_optional.ranking_sensibility: 0-5 Groq judge: are the most on-topic items ranked first?

evaluation_design.references_note: Recall@K, Precision@K, MRR, and nDCG are standard ranking / retrieval metrics (information retrieval literature and RAG evaluation surveys). LLM judges are approximate and complement—not replace—label-based metrics.

scenarios.description: Query paraphrases stored summary; should rank therapy goal memory above filler.

tasks.query: What relaxation habit did I say I wanted to try at night?
ranked_summaries_preview: User wants to practice a five-minute breathing exercise before sleep to reduce anxiety.
User mentioned liking rainy weather and drinking chai on weekends.
User cancelled gym membership due to schedule conflict.

scenarios.description: Two distinct memories are both relevant to a composite query.

tasks.query: Remind me what family health stress and academic deadlines I'm juggling.
ranked_summaries_preview: User is worried about mother hospitalization in Pune next month.
User has final dissertation submission on the same week as mother's procedure.
User enjoys playing tabla on Sundays.

scenarios.description: Two similar-sounding memories; only one matches the named entity.

tasks.query: What happened with Ravi at work regarding deadlines?
ranked_summaries_preview: User argued with colleague Ravi about project deadlines.
User's friend Ravi from college is visiting next week for a wedding.
User prefers video calls over email for team updates.

scenarios.description: Same text as another user's memory must not leak; corpus for this user has one item.

tasks.query: What exam subject am I scared about?
ranked_summaries_preview: User disclosed fear of failing organic chemistry retake.

scenarios.description: Very short query; measures stability / contamination rather than high recall.
